title: Alphabet DoD AI Deal Sparks Employee Protests And Investor Questions
title_zh: Alphabet DoD 人工智能交易引发员工抗议和投资者质疑
summary: Google has revised its contract with the U.S. Department of Defense to provide advanced AI capabilities for classified projects. The updated agreement gives the Pentagon broader access to Alphabet's AI models for secret government work.
summary_zh: 谷歌修改了与美国国防部的合同，为机密项目提供先进的人工智能功能。更新后的协议使五角大楼能够更广泛地访问 Alphabet 的人工智能模型，以进行秘密政府工作。

title: The wheels could be coming off the circular computing deal train
title_zh: 循环计算交易列车的轮子可能会脱落
summary: The big AI labs’ circular dealmaking, in which corporate investors invest capital in exchange for commitments of future contracts for computing resources, may be less failsafe than it seems.
summary_zh: 大型人工智能实验室的循环交易（即企业投资者投资资本以换取未来计算资源合同的承诺）可能并不像看上去那么安全。

title: BASF Coatings Launches $2 Billion Debt Sale To Fund Carlyle Acquisition
title_zh: 巴斯夫涂料公司启动 20 亿美元债务出售，为凯雷收购提供资金
summary: This article first appeared on GuruFocus. Banks have moved to launch a debt sale exceeding $2 billion tied to the carve-out of BASF SE's (BASFY) coatings division, a deal that could offer a timely read on investor appetite for chemicals exposure.
summary_zh: 本文首发于 GuruFocus。银行已着手启动一项超过 20 亿美元的债务出售，与剥离巴斯夫股份公司 (BASFY) 涂料部门相关，这项交易可以及时了解投资者对化学品敞口的兴趣。

title: SiriusXM and iHeartMedia in early merger talks
title_zh: SiriusXM 和 iHeartMedia 正在进行早期合并谈判
summary: A deal would unite the largest terrestrial and satellite radio networks in the U.S., forming a combined company with more than $12 billion in sales
summary_zh: 这笔交易将联合美国最大的地面和卫星广播网络，组建一家销售额超过 120 亿美元的合并公司

title: Forvia Sells Auto Interiors Business to Apollo Funds in $2.1 Billion Deal
title_zh: Forvia 以 21 亿美元的价格将汽车内饰业务出售给 Apollo Funds
summary: The French auto parts supplier said the deal allows it to sharpen focus on high value-added, technology-driven activities, while shoring up its balance sheet.
summary_zh: 这家法国汽车零部件供应商表示，此次交易使其能够更加关注高附加值、技术驱动的活动，同时支撑其资产负债表。
